reason: I have a lump sum sitting in NRO and I am scared of getting the TDS and 15CA/15CB paperwork wrong, so a CA call before anything moves and a fee taken only on arrival lowers the risk enough to try it. I would still check the FINTRAC number and the bank name myself, and probably send one tranche first.
objection: I have never heard of REPAIHUB and this is ₹20 lakh or more. I need to be sure the money moves through the named RBI-authorised bank and not through them, and that the CA is a real, verifiable person.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the FINTRAC registration verify on the public registry, and the named partner bank and CA confirmed independently, or a reference from someone I trust in an NRI forum.
